title: Why You Should Go for a 'Color Walk'
paragraphs: It's nice to go for a walk. You can get outside, get some exercise, and stop thinking about all the other things in your life — like work or school.
But what if you can't stop thinking about all those other things?
You might want to try a "color walk."
Color walks have been getting popular on social media. Mental health experts say they help people slow down, look around and just enjoy being outside.
They also help you stop looking at your phone all the time!
First, choose one color and look for it on your walk. If you choose blue, for example, you might notice a blue car or a blue flower.
When you find something in your color, take some time to really look at it. What shape is it? Is it big or small? Is it all the same color, or is some of it maybe lighter or darker?
If you enjoy taking photos, you can take pictures of nice things you see in your color. Or you can just try to see how many you can see.
This will help you think about what you're doing right now, not work or school or something you read on the internet.

You don't need to walk to a special place — it can be a place you've walked around many times before. When you slow down and really start looking, you might be surprised by how many new things you notice!
